messages:
Elena: Starting a quick thread for the vectors preview + export UI. Focus: keyboard flow, column toggles (rerank + source), filename UX, and copy tone. Figma: https://figma.com/file/ijkl
Elena: Sketch notes: per-file limit 10k rows, preview shows sample 5 rows, export modal with format toggle (CSV / JSONL), and a 'split into parts' checkbox.
Marcus - Eng: Backend supports streaming multi-part zips. We'll append .part1, .part2. Gzip optional. Important: emitting consistent column order for CSV.
Tara (PM): Product ask: default include id + embedding values only. Add optional toggles: include source_text, include_rerank_metadata. Rerank toggle off by default for GA.
Nadia - A11y: A11y checklist: modal focus trap, export progress should be announced to SR via aria-live=polite. The 'rows selected' widget needs sr-only text. Color contrast: badge for parts fails AA.
Elena: Copy options for header. Short list: A) 'Download embeddings (CSV / JSONL)' B) 'Export vector rows and metadata' Which is clearer?
Tara (PM): A is clearer for end users. Add small link 'How exports work' under header.
Omar - Data: For rerank metadata we'll include rerank_rank and rerank_score. Also: warn if selected rows have mixed embedding dims. Prefer failing with explicit row ids.
Marcus - Eng: Note on truncation: front-end preview can truncate long source_text with 'Show full' link. Backend exports full text unless user enables 'truncate fields' checkbox. Recommend default = full.
Nadia - A11y: Tooltips must be keyboard accessible and have role='tooltip'. Also ensure ESC closes tooltip & modal. Provide focusable examples for JSONL sample: `{"id":"r1","embedding":[0.1,0.2]}`
Elena: Filename UX: preview editable input default `<dataset>-vectors-<model>-YYYYMMDD.ext`. If split, append `.partN`. Show estimated size live under filename.
Tara (PM): Add small motion: when user toggles columns/formats update estimate. If estimate > 100MB show confirmation modal for large export.
Marcus - Eng: We'll implement client-side estimate: rows * dim * 4 bytes approximated for CSV + overhead. Will pipe warning thresholds. Backend ticket INF-8401 created for gzipping parts.
Omar - Data: Add a note: when including rerank metadata, export will include 'rerank_model' column only if available to avoid schema drift.
Elena: Accessibility + UX final asks before I update figma: - pick header copy (A) - ensure aria-describedby IDs for limit text - show estimated file size and per-file row limit - editable filename preview + .partN logic - confirmation for >100MB exports - tooltips accessible
Tara (PM): Confirm A, rerank off by default, docs link in modal. Prioritize a11y items.
Nadia - A11y: I'll do a quick audit after figma update: keyboard order, aria-live behavior, contrast fixes.
deploy-bot: snapshot uploaded: https://redwood.design/snapshots/1769000000
Marcus - Eng: noted INF-8401. Will link PR when started
Elena: Thanks team! I'll post follow-up with locked copy and updated figma. :sparkles:
